author: Dalium
body:
Hello my name is Dmhspys.

I was banned by Crazy_Creeper521 for Fly Hacks, No Slow Down, and No Fall.

I do not deny these hacks, but I also no longer use them. The day I hacked was the day I downloaded the software. I came onto Avicus to test em out, and I got caught and banned for doing so.

Avicus is one of my favorite servers and I am sorry for hacking on this server. Truthfully hacking just ruins the excitement of the game and I was dumb enough to try it on a server I love. Nebula is one of my favorite games to play and I would like to go back to playing it as a normal player. I am not very good at these letters, but I need you too know that I am sorry and won't hack again on this server.

title: Appeal

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Hello, 

Thank you for taking the time to appeal, however since you admit that you were in-fact cheating--the same length of ban applies to you as to anyone else who cheats on our server. 

This appeal is denied, you will need to wait around 4 more months to appeal.
Remember, if you want a chance at an appeal down the road, please do not ban evade (logging onto another account will impede your chances on getting unbanned).

Thank you for understanding,
-John
